targets.authors: Borreggine, K. L., & Kaschak, M. P.
targets.title: The action–sentence compatibility effect: It's all in the timing.
targets.evidence_quote: As a first step in assessing the replicability of motor compatibility effects, we conducted a pre-registered, multi-lab replication of the ACE. We used an adapted version of the original ACE paradigm (Glenberg & Kaschak, 2002) that was used in Borreggine and Kaschak (2006).
targets.outcome_quote: The results of the replication effort are clear: This version of the ACE was not statistically significant in any of the individual studies, and the meta-analytic effect size was close to zero (see Fig. 6).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall verdict is a clear failure for this version of ACE in all 18 labs, with a near-zero pooled effect.
